title: Before the Tide
tagline: Guess the word before the sea does.
teaser: A sandcastle, an incoming tide and a hidden word. Every right letter carves a window; every wrong one sends a wave. Seven waves and the beach takes it back. The Berkeley word game, rebuilt on a beach drawn entirely in code.

manPage.synopsis: Before the Tide — guess the hidden word letter by letter before seven waves take the sandcastle.
manPage.description: Ken Arnold's word-guessing game from the Berkeley distribution, reborn on a beach. Right letters write themselves into the wet sand and decorate a sandcastle; wrong ones send waves that wash it away a piece at a time. The original's golf-style average lives on as the tide average, with nine for a lost word, and Classic keeps its 1983 rules.

howToPlay: Guess the hidden word one letter at a time: type it, or click a shell.
Each wrong letter sends a wave that washes part of the castle away; seven waves and the tide wins.
Your tide average is the waves per word, golf-style: lower is better, and a lost word counts nine.
